content: Ad network thresholds (2025-2026): AdSense has no minimum traffic requirement, ~68% revenue share, accepts small/gaming sites with original content. Playwire requires 500k monthly pageviews + GA installed. Nitro (gaming-focused, NitroPay) requires 100k monthly visitors / 300k monthly pageviews. Venatus publishes no hard minimum but is selective, favors established gaming/esports properties. Freestar requires ~1M monthly pageviews + 6mo history. None of the gaming-specific premium networks fit a 30-50k pageview/mo site except Ezoic (see below) and AdSense.
